segments.text: GOD ſtandeth in the congregacion of princes: He is iudge emong Gods.
Howe long will ye geue wrong iudgement: and accept the perſons of the vngodly?
Defende the poore and fatherleſſe: ſee that ſuche as bee in nede and neceſſitie haue right.
Deliuer the outcaſt and poore: Saue them from the hande of the vngodly.
They will not be learned nor vnderſtande, but walke on ſtill in darkeneſſe: all the foundacions of the earth be out of courſe.
I haue ſayed, ye are Gods: and ye all are children of the the moſte higheſt.
But ye ſhall dye lyke men: and fal lyke one of the princes.
Ariſe, O God, and iudge thou the earth: For thou ſhalt take all the Heathen to thyne inheritaunce.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning, is nowe. &c.
